titles.en: Stele of Zhang Menglong, Ming rubbing

relationships.note: The Palace Museum identifies the album as a Ming rubbing of this stele.

currentCollection.note: The Palace Museum catalogues a 36-page album. The dates of the stone’s transfers apply only to the stone.
currentCollection.noteZh: 故宫著录为三十六页剪裱册。原石的迁移年份仅适用于原石。

review.note: Draft from the cited collection entry. Independent editorial review remains pending.
review.noteZh: 据所引馆藏条目整理的草稿，尚待独立编辑审核。

notes: The catalogue does not identify a storage room or establish current display status.
notesZh: 所引条目没有给出库房位置，也未核实目前的展出状态。
